name: adnanh/webhook Self-Hosted
free_limit: MIT-licensed self-hosted HTTP webhook receiver that maps configurable JSON/YAML hook rules to local commands or scripts; no vendor-imposed webhook, endpoint, or event quota.
watch_out: Executes server-side commands: secure every exposed hook with signatures, trigger rules, least-privilege accounts and HTTPS/reverse proxy before production use. Requires your own host and operations; compute, bandwidth, TLS infrastructure and integrations may cost extra. No hosted delivery/retry service is included.
